description: This file defines an asynchronous waiting utility function `waitUntil` with timeout handling, including an error type `AsyncWaitTimeoutError` to indicate timeout occurrences.

classes.name: AsyncWaitTimeoutError
classes.description: An error type indicating a timeout occurred while waiting for a condition.

methods.name: waitUntil
methods.description: An asynchronous function that repeatedly evaluates a condition until it returns true or a timeout occurs.
